doc.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025

title: Supporting live music and local scenes
summary: Responding to a quote from his website, Palmer says local music matters more now.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
